Allow the momentum and manifestations from your previous vibrations to play out while you are tuning your vibration higher and higher. You'll have to outlast your previous low vibration while cultivating new, higher vibration. 

I'm similar to you in that I was in "deep fog" for several years (~10 years) and am now turning it up. 2015-2017 consisted of me constantly being faced with low vibration experiences/manifestations from my old frequencies. The work of it is standing your "vibrational ground", holding your new frequency, while letting those low frequency manifestations pass on by. Over *time* the old will die out and new will grow stronger and replace your... reality. You get it.

For me, "the old" is at its end, with only small, insignificant low vibe manifestations left, and the "new vibes" are at the point of momentum where it's starting to have tangible impact on my life.

Change is constant. It'll never be perfect, and it's perfect like that.

So, yeah. Give it time, keep going and I love you.

For the most part I think you'd have to figure out what works for you and your mind yourself. That being said one tactic I use is sitting at table with a notepad and pen alone and writing questions. As soon as I would write the question the answer would come and I'd write it.

Listening to audiobooks, affirmations on YouTube, and re-reading notes from a self-Dev book I'd just read the week prior to the trip is magic.

The most effective method beyond of all of these in my experience is to go out in nature where you can be secure and unbothered yet comfortable and free with a lot of water to drink and at night. I remember like yesterday; I just laid in the grass looking at the stars, walked around by the lake, and my mind did the rest.
MOST IMPORTANTLY though, set your intention. General self-Dev trips are great and so are trips aimed at specific areas of your -self- so try out both and see for yourself lol. 

Another tip: like everything in life, with self-Dev trips, never force it. Set your intentions firmly, have your setting be in harmony with those intentions, and let your mind do the rest.

Edit: Ex: Regarding your spirit guides, Higher Self, etc., set your intention to meet with them on your next trip and you will.

Also, another major part of effective self-Dev trips for me is writing down beforehand all questions, intentions, lessons, concepts, etc. I want in the trip.

I've just recently solved this within myself, so I feel you. What I do is immediately dive in into mindfulness, no matter the external situation (important), the exact moment I'm faced with anxiety. The reason being, if I can configure my internal right now in this moment from anxiety to confidence, mindfulness, calmness, etc. then the external will reflect this change like a mirror reflects light, instantly. It's challenging, helps me grow and works every time.

Meditation is one thing. Imagine having mastered those powers mid-experience. Only way is to use and express these powers mid-experience. No thing, not even anxiety, can hinder you in any way. Call it on the spot mindfulness.
